sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} spotted seal was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Spotted seals live in the North Pacific and Arctic seas and use the edge of the sea ice in spring to give birth.
His last position was also his farthest, {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began: {species_rank_distance}.
In between, his tag went quiet for {longest_gap_days}.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
